display.title: T4: The Fusion Reactor
display.subtitle: The capstone power project
description: The §bFusion Reactor§r is the Tier 4 power capstone - enormous, sustained RF
that comfortably runs a late-game factory and, crucially, the §bSPS§r.
Build the reactor frame around a §bFusion Reactor Controller§r and ignite it
with a Hohlraum of D-T fuel. Holding the controller completes this beat.
§7This is the single biggest RF source in the pack. You build it because the
next beat - antimatter - needs the draw only fusion can sustain.
